card.name: Digits inside numbers before units
card.fires_on: Digits or quantity words partway through a number, just before a unit such as billion, lbs, GeV, mg or terabit. Also 'a' and 'few' in 'a few hundred'.

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A middle or last digit of a multi-digit number, with a unit coming next.
modes.example: Worth Over 1<<6>>7 Billion Pounds of Cure

modes.label: Weight in lbs
modes.description: Digit in a converted pound weight after a kg value.
modes.example: under 50 kg (11<<0>> lbs) of body weight

modes.label: Rough quantity words
modes.description: The words 'a' or 'few' before 'hundred' in an approximate amount.
modes.example: masses of a<< few>> hundred GeV/c2

card.writes: Little clear output effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of unrelated names and Chinese characters, and the suppressed ones are kilo-type pieces.
card.plain: It fires inside a number or amount just before its unit, such as pounds, kg or mg.
